title: AnnaBooks at a glance
subtitle: Accounting for consulting and staffing companies
transcript: Meet AnnaBooks: accounting software for consulting and staffing companies.
Sign in once, and every company you run keeps its own separate set of books.
The Overview map shows how sales, consultants, bills, and the bank connect, and each box opens its screen.
Customer Center shows each customer's invoices, receipts, and balance in one place.
Bill consultant hours straight from timesheets, and follow every invoice until it is paid.
Enter vendor bills, then pay them by check, bank, or card. The books update for you.
Banking keeps your accounts, deposits, transfers, credit cards, and loans together.
Profit and loss, balance sheet, and aging reports are ready the moment you save.
Start your AnnaBooks account at annaccounting.com. The full guide is at guide.annaccounting.com.

title: Getting started
subtitle: Create your account and your first company
transcript: Getting started with AnnaBooks takes a few minutes.
On the AnnaBooks start page, choose Client to keep your company's books.
Create your account with your name and email, then verify the six digit code we send you.
Pick the guided Start Setup, or Quick Setup if you already know accounting.
Enter your company details once: name, federal I D, address, and time zone.
Choose your industry. I T consulting adds consultants, timesheets, and payroll to your menus.
Your new company appears as a card. Click it to open the books.
The first time you open it, load a ready-made chart of one hundred thirteen accounts.
Start your AnnaBooks account at annaccounting.com. The full guide is at guide.annaccounting.com.

title: Inside your company
subtitle: Overview, Tracker, and your team
transcript: Here is your company's home in AnnaBooks.
Overview is a map of your daily work. Every box opens the screen for that job.
Tracker lists open invoices with their due days, so you know exactly who to follow up with.
Invite your accountant or your team members to work in the same company.
Your profile, password, and session timer live under Settings.
Start your AnnaBooks account at annaccounting.com. The full guide is at guide.annaccounting.com.

title: Customers and invoicing
subtitle: From invoice to payment
transcript: Customers and invoicing in AnnaBooks.
Customer Center shows a customer's balance, invoices, and receipts at a glance.
Add a customer once, with payment terms, contacts, and billing addresses.
Create an invoice. Consulting companies add timesheet hours right on it.
Every invoice shows its status, from sent, to partially paid, to received.
Receive Payment applies money to open invoices, like the two thousand six hundred eighty dollars Cedar Schools still owes.
The receivables aging report shows who owes you, and for how long.
Start your AnnaBooks account at annaccounting.com. The full guide is at guide.annaccounting.com.

title: Consultants, time, and payroll
subtitle: Built for consulting and staffing firms
transcript: Consultants, timesheets, and payroll, built in.
Consultant Center keeps each consultant's agreement, bill rate, pay rate, and timesheets.
See your whole bench of consultants in one list.
Timesheet Summary shows every week's hours by consultant and customer.
Contract Tracking shows which contracts are active, expiring, or expired.
Record payroll from timesheets, and keep the history of every pay run.
Payroll reports show earnings, reimbursements, deductions, and net pay.
Start your AnnaBooks account at annaccounting.com. The full guide is at guide.annaccounting.com.

title: Vendors and bills
subtitle: From bill to check
transcript: Vendors and bills in AnnaBooks.
Vendor Center brings each supplier's bills and payments together.
Enter a bill once, and it posts what you owe to accounts payable.
The bills list shows every bill's status, from open to paid.
Pay Bill lists a vendor's open bills. Tick them and pay by check, bank, or card.
Vendor Payments keeps every payment on record, like check twenty two oh four to Deskline.
Write and print checks straight from the payments you have recorded.
Start your AnnaBooks account at annaccounting.com. The full guide is at guide.annaccounting.com.

title: Banking, cards, and loans
subtitle: Every account in one place
transcript: Banking, cards, and loans in AnnaBooks.
Bank Accounts groups your checking and savings accounts under each bank.
Make Deposit moves received payments from undeposited funds into the bank.
Transfer funds between your accounts in a few clicks.
Track company credit cards, their charges, and every card payment.
Loans record what you borrowed and each repayment, principal and interest.
Every movement lands in the general ledger, line by line.
Start your AnnaBooks account at annaccounting.com. The full guide is at guide.annaccounting.com.

title: Inventory and company records
subtitle: Stock, accounts, and journal entries
transcript: Inventory and company records in AnnaBooks.
Inventory Centre shows stock on hand, prices, and the history of each item.
Stock adjustments record count changes, with a reason for each one.
The chart of accounts comes ready made, and you can add your own accounts.
Journal entries handle anything no other screen covers.
The Transactions Center lists every posted transaction in one place.
Start your AnnaBooks account at annaccounting.com. The full guide is at guide.annaccounting.com.

title: Reports
subtitle: Know where the business stands
transcript: Reports in AnnaBooks.
Reports Home groups every report by area of the business.
Profit and loss shows income and expenses for any period, on an accrual or cash basis.
The balance sheet shows what you own, what you owe, and your equity.
The trial balance checks that debits and credits match.
Cash flow shows where the cash came from and where it went.
Export any report to C S V, or print it for your files.
Start your AnnaBooks account at annaccounting.com. The full guide is at guide.annaccounting.com.

title: Settings
subtitle: Make AnnaBooks fit your company
transcript: Settings make AnnaBooks fit your company.
Company details, address, and currency live in one place.
Account Configuration turns features such as bonus, discount, and sales tax on when you need them.
Brand your invoices and documents with your own logo and colors.
Connect Gmail or Outlook to send invoices from your own address.
Export your data any time. Your books stay yours.
